patch.summary: Pipedrive implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Pipedrive by mapping current crm workflows to Pipedrive objects, confirming plan gates for email sync (Growth, Premium, Ultimate), email tracking (Growth, Premium, Ultimate), email sequences (Growth, Premium, Ultimate), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Gmail, Slack, Microsoft Teams) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: email sync (Growth, Premium, Ultimate)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Gmail

blocks.heading: Pipedrive day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Pipedrive setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves SMB and mid-market sales teams prioritizing pipeline visibility before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Gmail and Slack before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover email sync (Growth, Premium, Ultimate)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Lite lacks full email sync and workflow automation — most active sales teams need Growth or higher.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Campaigns and Web Visitors remain paid add-ons on all plans; LeadBooster/Projects/Smart Docs are add-ons below Premium.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Ultimate introduces explicit caps (e.g. custom fields, teams, reports) versus the older unlimited Enterprise packaging.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Native full telephony/AI suite calling is limited compared with Freshsales-style all-in-one phone + scoring bundles; deeper calling relies on Marketplace apps.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Pipedrive plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Lite
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Growth
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: email sync, email tracking, email sequences · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Premium
lines.description: 14-day trial · Unlocks: lead scoring, data enrichment, prospecting · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Ultimate
lines.description: 14-day trial · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep Pipedrive rollout
blocks.body: If Pipedrive fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Pipedrive object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Freshsales before sunk-cost expansion
